# Data360 Beast Full Agent Context

Data360 Beast is a curated Salesforce Data 360 operating kit for agentic IDEs.
It is not a Salesforce docs mirror. It gives agents a source hierarchy, phase
router, API workflow, and validation contract.

## Entry Points

- Homepage: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/
- Repository: https://github.com/architect-bertie/data360beast
- Skill folder: https://github.com/architect-bertie/data360beast/tree/main/skills/data360beast
- Compact LLM file: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/llms.txt
- Manifest: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/agent-manifest.json

## Source Hierarchy

1. User-provided target org, files, data space, API version, and business goal.
2. Official Salesforce docs fetched on demand.
3. User-supplied or locally available Data 360 Connect API OpenAPI spec.
4. Data360 Beast cookbook and scorecard.
5. Live org validation in an explicitly authorized org.

## Operating Loop

1. Classify the phase.
2. Identify the proof target.
3. Fetch official docs on demand.
4. Search OpenAPI for the API shape.
5. Apply the cookbook.
6. Validate in org when authorized.
7. Label confidence as documented, tested, or inferred.

## Phase Router

- Connect: connectors, connections, schema, refresh, ingestion setup.
- Prepare: data streams, DLOs, transforms, document processing.
- Harmonize: DMOs, mappings, relationships, identity resolution, data graphs.
- Govern: data spaces, classifications, tags, access policies, security.
- Retrieve: Query SQL, Query v2, Profile API, metadata discovery.
- Insight: calculated insights, streaming insights, SQL validation.
- Semantic: semantic models, metrics, dimensions, shared dimensions.
- AI/Search: search indexes, retrievers, unstructured retrieval, grounding.
- Segment: segment create/read/publish/count, DBT segments, membership proof.
- Act: activation targets, activations, data action targets, data actions.
- Automation: triggered flows, events, activation-triggered flows, monitoring.

## Live-Tested Cookbook Notes

- Data space and metadata discovery are safe first checks.
- Query SQL and Profile API provide useful proof for data and metadata.
- DBT segment create worked with `includeDbt.models.models[]`.
- DBT segment readback can normalize to `includeDbt.models[]`.
- Approximate segment count can fail when the feature is disabled.
- Segment members depend on a delta window; status and count readback are better
  first proofs.
- Data action target and data action create were validated in lab.
- Activation target create/read was validated by returned ID.
- Search index and calculated insight list were explored, but creation recipes
  require enabled assets before promotion.

## Public Boundary

This repository intentionally excludes raw Salesforce Help exports, generated
caches, lab data, credentials, and org-specific metadata. Agents should fetch
official docs on demand and use this repository as the curated operating layer.

- Core Data 360 architecture: 9.3/10
- Governance and data spaces: 9.0/10
- Segment, act, automation: 9.2/10
- Overall Beast mode: 9.4/10
